title: The summary for a fish sorting measurement
description: Contains the amount, types and estimated weights of fish sorted during a fish sorting measurement

amount.description: The amount of detected individual fish during the sorting measurement

weight.description: The measured, estimated or calculated total weight of the fish

average_confidence.description: The average of the confidence scores for the detections of the fish species and weight during the sorting measurement

fish_species.description: The total amount of fish detected for a specific species

items.description: The fish species and the total amount detected for that species

amount.description: The total amount of fish detected for the species

weight.description: The total weight of fish detected for the species

species_code.description: The type of the product, e.g. a type of fish. This is a 3-letter FAO fish species code
